scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Failed to show empathy at [02:50] when customer voiced extreme panic regarding his 14-year-old son stranded alone at a train station in the rain.

grader.scenario: Family Share multi-SIM plan: secondary SIM not receiving shared data allowance
grader.notes: Solid technical and operational resolution of Family Share data allocation, but agent failed empathy when customer voiced severe anxiety regarding his 14-year-old son stranded alone at a railway station.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net mobile customer care' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Ian throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Customer expressed acute distress and fear regarding his stranded teenage son; agent offered zero empathy and moved directly to system lookups.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent restated the family shared data pool omission accurately at [01:30].

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent confirmed son's mobile number accurately without repeating questions.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent manually allocated 30GB quota, verified 5G connection, and locked recurring monthly allocation.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained a courteous and helpful tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked targeted diagnostic questions regarding splash screen errors and app behavior.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer confirmed son toggled aeroplane mode, refreshed digital train ticket, and boarded five-forty train.
